faq.q: Ɗum ko ɗoo'e ɗi'e ɗuum ngam neɓɓe ɓe nguurɗi?
faq.a: Ɗoo'e ɗi'e ɗuum ɗi'e sahɗi, ɗi'e anndaa, ɗi'e wara sakitin: daa'iri mawni ngam wuurtude, sortirgol, tuurgal ɗi'e sahɗi, ɗaɓɓitol winndugo ɗi'e anndaa, lollitol, gaɗɗe ngam daa'iri bingo bee kaarte ngam winndude. Ɗi'e ɗuum ɗoo'e ngam neɓɓe ɓe nguurɗi, ɗum ngam neɓɓe ɓe ɓaawi ɗum ndaani hakkilo. Ko ɗum ɗe ɗe'ata ngam neɓɓe ɗum ɗo hannde ɗum ɗum ɗi'a. Hiɗa ɓilaaji, ɗaraje bee ko ɗum ɗe ɗi'a ɗum ngam jarribaa.
Oho. Kala fijo e tappirde e Creative Activities ko mbelnaari, alaa konte, winnditaade walla ƴettude. Pijirlooji ɗii ina ndoga e nder feerorde web e telefoŋ, tablet walla ordinateer.

faq.q: Mbele pijirlooji ngaandi ina kaɗa ñawu nguu?
faq.a: No game has been shown to prevent dementia, and Creative Activities does not claim to treat or prevent anything. Our games are for enjoyment and time together, and no activity page makes a health claim.

faq.q: Mbele ɗeen pijirlooji ina moƴƴi e neɗɗo mo ñawu Alzheimer ?
faq.a: Oho. Ñawu Alzheimer ɓuri heewde saabaade ŋakkeende hakkille, pijirlooji ɗii mbaɗata ko ngam ɗum : natal mawngal heddotoo ko hollirde, suɓngooji seeɗa, alaa ko siftortee walla ko bonnata. Matching, renndinde e timminde konnguɗi ganndaaɗi ina tuugii e gannde ɓooyɗe, wonaa e jaŋde hesere.

faq.q: Mbele neɗɗo jogiiɗo rafi dementia caggal mum ina waawi huutoraade ɗeen golle ?
faq.a: Heewi, eey, e won e sara maɓɓe. Fuɗɗoraade e Yiytu ko nanndi e natal ɗiɗi, Natal gonngal e kaɓirɗe nay, hello koloor walla fooftere calminaande. Waɗde juutde, rewa e maɓɓe, njooɗto so ɓe keɓii.
Lowre ndee alaa konte, alaa kadi yeeyirde. Min kuutortoo ko Google Analytics ngam faamde hol kelle njiylotooɗe. Fotooje ɗe cuɓ-ɗaa ngam Photo pairs kollirtee tan ko e feerorde maa, ɗe meeɗaa neldude.

Creative Activities ɗum ko tebal ɗi'e ɗum sahɗi, ɗi'e ngaɗi ngaɗaaɗe daa'iri ɗi'e neɓɓe ngam kala ko kujjitoo ko feere, ngam net bee ɗum ko app bilaa ɗoŋɗe. Min aɗa ɓe ɓaawi ɗum ngam ɗum ɓe ɗi'a ɗum, bee ɗum ɗum ɗo'a ɗum ɗum ɗo'a ɗum ngam ɗi'e ɗuum bilaa ɗoŋɗe.

about.bodyHtml:
Who it is for

Anyone caring for someone: a parent, a grandparent, a child, a partner, a friend, or a person living with dementia. Families, older adults and activity staff can all use the same pages.

What we believe

The point of an activity is the moment itself: a conversation, a smile, the satisfaction of putting two pictures together, or simply sitting close. It is not to measure anyone, push them further or prove anything.

Many brain-training apps are designed around speed, scores, streaks and levels. For someone who is tired, unwell or living with dementia, that can feel like an exam they cannot pass. We designed the opposite, and we hold ourselves to these rules:

  • Nothing to fail. No clock, score, move counter, lives, streaks, confetti or countdowns, on any screen.
  • Recognition over recall. Pictures stay showing by default. Prompts invite conversation and never quiz names or memories.
  • Big, plain and steady. Large text and pictures, high contrast, and controls that stay in the same place.
  • Adult dignity. Real-world pictures and plain, warm words. No cartoons, sing-song praise or emoji rewards.
  • An easy way out. “Done for now” is always visible. Stopping halfway is a good outcome.
  • Private by default. No accounts or ads. Photos you choose stay on your device.

What we do not claim

Our games and activities are for enjoyment and connection. They do not diagnose, test, measure, treat, slow or prevent dementia or Alzheimer’s disease, and no one should choose them for that reason. When we write about health research, we say plainly where the evidence is weak, and we never connect it to our own activities.

Who we are

Creative Activities is a small independent team. We are not clinicians. Our guides are written from published guidance by organizations such as the National Institute on Aging and the Alzheimer’s Association, and every guide lists its sources. Read how we write and check our pages.

Tell us what would help

We would love to hear what works for you and what does not, especially from people living with dementia, family caregivers and activity staff. Email {email}.

editorial.title: No Min Mbinndirta e No Ƴeewtortoɗen Kelle Men
editorial.description: Hay Kuutorɗe Mallooji ɓiɗɗata, ɓiɗɗata, jaɓɓata e hesɗata kuutorɗe maɓɓe kuutorɗe mallooji e lafdi, e ɗume min alaa ɓiɗɗan.
editorial.bodyHtml:
Our sources

We base our guides on public guidance from organizations such as the National Institute on Aging, the CDC, the Alzheimer’s Association, the Alzheimer’s Foundation of America, the Family Caregiver Alliance and the NHS, and on peer-reviewed research such as Cochrane reviews and large clinical trials. Every guide lists the sources it relies on. We open each source before citing it, and we only report what it actually says.

How we write

  • Practical first: what to do today, in plain language.
  • Honest about evidence: we say “linked with”, “may” and “the evidence is mixed” when that is the truth.
  • Respectful: we write about people living with dementia as adults, and we never use quizzing or shaming language.
  • No invented content: no made-up statistics, quotes, experts, studies, reviews or testimonials.

Who reviews our pages

Pages are written and checked by the Creative Activities team. Some drafting and research use AI tools, as described below. Every page is checked against its sources by the team. Our pages have not been reviewed by a doctor or other clinician, and we do not claim otherwise. They are general information, not medical advice.

How AI is used

We use AI tools to help with research, first drafts, translation drafts and formatting. A person edits every page against its sources. AI does not test activities: a person tries each activity before it is published. No AI-generated step, image or review is presented as verified, and we do not publish AI-written reviews or testimonials. No generated image is shown as a photo of a real activity.

What we will never publish

  • Claims that a game, food, supplement, fast or routine prevents, treats, slows or cures dementia.
  • Tests, quizzes or scores that suggest someone has, or does not have, dementia.
  • Advice to start, stop or change any medicine.
  • Advertising or sponsored content disguised as guidance.

Updates and corrections

Each page shows the date it was last updated. If you find a mistake or an out-of-date source, please email {email} and we will check it promptly.

faq.title: Naamne e Jaabawuuli
faq.seoTitle: Kuutorɗe e Jaabaaji Ngam Kuutorɗe Mallooji
faq.description: Answers to common questions about the games and activities: which to try, how long to play, groups and later-stage ideas, health and privacy.
faq.lede: Jaabawuuli juutɗi, laaɓtuɗi e naamne ɗe toppitiiɓe ɓuri naamnaade.

items.q: Ɗume ko kuutorɗe ɓurɗe ngam ɓe mawɓe?
items.a: Pijirlooji ɓurɗi moƴƴude ɗii ko ganndaaɗi, ko koyɗi, ɗi ngalaa tampere, kadi ko foti wonde ko neɗɗo oo weltotoo hannde. Natal jokkondirngal e natal yiyteteengal, sortude, jigsaws koyɗi, timminde konnguɗi ganndaaɗi, coloring e natal bingo fof ina golloo no moƴƴi e yimɓe heewɓe. Reento waktuuji, limtooji e kala ko nanndi e jarribo.
Oho. Pijirlooji e binnditagol fof ko njoɓdi, alaa konte, winnditaade, ƴettude walla yeeyde.

items.q: Hol ko waɗi alaa limlebbi, toɓɓe walla waktuuji?
items.a: Jaawgol e limlebbi ina mbaɗta golle belɗe e ekkol, ina waawi addude hersa walla mette. Min njokkii e weltaare e sahaa gooto, ko ɗuum waɗi alaa ko ŋakki e aɗa waawi dartaade e kala sahaa.

Kala telefoŋ, tablet walla ordinateer jogiiɗo feerorde web jamaanu. Tablet e dow darnde e dow taabal ina heewi wonde ko ɓuri welde e yimɓe ɗiɗo ngam fijde bannge e bannge. Laptop jokkondirɗo e tele ina golloo no moƴƴi e pelle.

items.q: Mbele eɗen mbaawi fijde e fotooje galle men?
items.a: Oho. Fotooji ɗiɗi ina mbaɗta fotooji 2 haa 6 ɗi cuɓ-ɗaa ɗii mbaɗta pijirlooji nannduɗi. Fotooje ɗee ina keddii e feerorde maa, ɗe ndartinaaka, ɗe ndartinaaka.
Heewi wonde ko hojomaaji 10 haa 20 ina keewi, won heen kadi hojomaaji 2 ina njuumta. Yeewtu maandeeji tampere walla mette e woppude tawa ina weli haa jooni. Alaa ko foti no limre.

items.q: Hol ko woni so ɓe njiɗaa waɗde golle ?
items.a: Hormo alaa, ƴeew kadi caggal walla e mbaadi ngoɗndi. Jaɓde ina waawi arde e tampere, mette, ŋakkere hoolaare walla tan waasde yiɗde. Ƴeew doggol amen ko foti waɗeede so ɓe mbiyii alaa.

items.q: Hol golle potɗe e dementia caggal?
items.a: Comfort e senngooji : heɗtaade jimɗi ɓurɗi yiɗeede, ɓuuɓnude juuɗe e loowdi, ƴeewde fotooje e nder heen, jogaade ɓuuɓri softunde, jooɗaade e yaasi, walla pijirlooji natal koyɗi no feewi tawa won e saraaji mum en. Giɗo men caggal ina jogii miijooji goɗɗi keewɗi.

items.q: Mbele ina woodi golle ngam pelle e nder galle toppitiiɗo?
items.a: Oho. Bingo natal ina jogii kaayitaaji tappirɗe e nodduɗo e ekran, e kaayitaaji Finish konngol e Yeewtere ina ngolloo no moƴƴi janngeede e daande toownde. Ardorde pelle men toppitiiɗe galleeji ina kaala mawnugol pelle, jooɗorde e jokkondire ngam baawɗe jillondirɗe.

items.q: Mbele pijirlooji ina mbaawi haɗde walla leeltinde dementia ?
items.a: Alaa fijo hollitaama ngam haɗde dementia, kadi fijooji men mbaɗaani ko wayi noon. Ƴellitaare hakkille e nder renndo hollitii nafooje tokoose e nder wiɗtooji wonande yimɓe wonduɓe e jabet fannu 2, kono ɗuum ina seerti e pijirlooji kaɗooji ñawu nguu. Min ndokka pijirlooji ngam weltinde e jokkondirde.

Wonaa e yaakaare. Wiɗtooji ina njokkondiri e geɗe 14 cellal e nguurndam e baasal dementia, ko wayi no ŋakkere nanɗe, ŋakkere ƴiiƴam, ŋakkeende golle ɓalli e ŋakkere renndo. Haɓde e majji ina waawi ustude baasal wonande won e yimɓe, kono heewɓe e waɗooɓe kala ko ina moƴƴi ina keɓa haa jooni ñawu nguu. Ko hay gooto meeɗaa waɗde.

items.q: Mbele koorka taƴka ina moƴƴi e cellal ngaandi?
items.a: Seedeeji aadee ina pamɗi, ina yaawi, tee ko ɓuri heewde e wiɗtooji ɗii ko e daabaaji. Koorka ina waawi wonde caɗeele wonande mawɓe, haa teeŋti noon e leɗɗe jabet walla ŋakkere teddeendi nde anniyaaka, tee ina moƴƴi e yimɓe wonduɓe e rafiiji. Yeewtid e doktoor hade maa waylude no ñaamirta.

Alaa konte walla jeeyngal. Min kuutortoo ko Google Analytics ngam limde njilluuji e ƴeewde hol kelle ballooje, kadi feerorde maa ina siftora so tawii a udditii sawtaaji softuɗi. Fotooje ɗe cuɓ-ɗaa ngam Photo pairs meeɗaa ƴetteede. Ƴeew bayyinaango sirlu ngam humpitaade.
Alaa Creative Activities ko ngam weltinde e humpitaade ko heewi. Ngam naamne cellal, kaaldu e doktoor, e ngam caɗeele noddu 911.

handout.introHtml: Nate mawɗe, konnguɗi laaɓtuɗi alaa ko ŋakki. Ko yowitii e telefoŋ, tablet walla ordinateer, alaa ko winnditoo, alaa ko yeeynata, alaa waktuuji e alaa ko limtaa. Jooɗto-ɗee bannge e bannge, mbaɗon njilluuji.
handout.gamesTitle: Pijirlooji ngam ƴeewndaade e nder renndo
handout.restHtml:
Wasiyaaji seeɗa

  • Suɓo waktu mo neɗɗo oo woni e mum.
  • Fuɗɗoraade e njuɓɓudi ɓurndi hoybude. Tileeji nay ina keewi.
  • Haala ko fayti e natal. Yeewtere ndee ina heewi wonde ko ɓuri moƴƴude.
  • Woppu nde ina weli haa jooni. Jokkude ko yaawi ko batte moƴƴe.

Kadi e lowre ndee

  • Tappirɗe ɗe njoɓaaka : njiylawu kelme mawɗe, kelle colour, kaayitaaji yeewtere e bingo natal.
  • Miijooji golle wonande kala daawal, e ballondiral e fijde e dow toppitaade hoore maa.

Ngam weltaare e wakkati kawtal. Wonaa wasiyaaji safrooɓe, jarribo walla safaara. Ko Cloudjet Solutions Pte yaltini deftere nde. Ltd.

Alal ɗuuɗe ngalaa kuɗe, hakkilo ... (no account, no advertising, no timer, no score). Sigeere ɗe ɗi ɗum ɓaawo ɗuuɗe ɗe jeyaaɗe ngam fedde, mawɓe e kaɗe-jaɓɗe, nder ɗuuɗe ɓeeɗaaɗe ... sources such as the National Institute on Aging and the Alzheimer's Association.

organizations.moreItemsHtml:
• Ɗereeji ngam jamaa: Bingo nder ɗereeji ɗum e kaarte ɗe ɓeeɗaaɗe, e ɗuuɗe ngam hiirugo ɗum e kiiɗe ngam jaabaaɗe e hakkilo ɗe ɓe ngalɗe nder ɗum.
  • Sigeere ngam ɗuuɗugo ngam kaɗe-jaɓɗe e fedde, ɓeeɗaaɗe nder ɗuuɗe ɓeeɗaaɗe e sources. Fuɗɗu ɗum e 101 hakkilo ɗuuɗugo walla ɗuuɗe jamaa ngam suudu mawɓe.
organizations.restHtml:
No pelle kuutortoo ɗum

  • Cuuɗi toppitagol e toppitagol ciftorgol: bingo natal walla timminde-haala e tele suudu renndo, tawa neɗɗo gooto ina tappa ngam fedde nde.
  • Porogaraamuuji ñalɗi mawɓe: station tablette e Picture pairs set e tile nay, ngam jokkondire juutɗe gooto-e-gooto.
  • Defte janngirɗe jamaa: njiylawu kelme tappirɗe e kaayitaaji jeewte e nder kaɓirɗe ciimtol, e lowre nde limtaa e tablette defterdu.
  • Pelle ballondiral toppitiiɓe e kafe ciftorgol: gooto deftere kelle wootere nde waawi tappeede ngam ɓesnguuji ɗii ƴetta galleeji mum en.
  • Ospitaaluuji e peewnitooɓe yaltinnde: deftere nde e nder paɗe toppitiiɗe, ngam huunde calminaande waɗde e galle walla e sara leeso.

Ko min mbaɗataa

Pijirlooji ɗii ko ngam weltinde e jokkondirde. Ɓe ƴeewtataa, ɓe ƴeewndataa, ɓe limtataa, ɓe safrataa walla ɓe leeltinaani ñawu nguu, eɗen ñaagii juɓɓule nde ngoppataa ɗum en noon. Alaa jeeyngal, kadi pijirlooji ɗii naamnaaki inɗe, nate cellal walla fotooje ngam jolnude. Lowre ndee huutortoo ko Google Analytics ngam limde njilluuji ; amin humpito sirlu ina fammina ko ɗuum moofti. Fotooji kuutorteeɗi e... Fotooji ɗiɗo heddo e nder feerorde ndee.

Ɓeydu min e doggol doole maa

So aɗa jogii doggol doole ngam toppitiiɓe, aɗa weltii e jokkondirde e {domain}. Aɗa waawi ƴettude sifaa gooto.

Kiiɗe walla jaɓɓugo

Si wonno ɗum ɗe nder site ɗo wonaa jaɓɗo walla ɗum wonaa bannge, on ɗoo ɗo mbiɗɗete kadi {email}. Ɗaɓɓitee hakkilo ɗi ngalaa, walla hakkilo ɗi ... ɓe ngalɗe nder kaaɗe ɗe ... Ɗaɓɓitee kadi wallude ɗi nder dole ɗi ɗo ɓe ngalɗe.

app.title: App Moments kaŋŋe
app.seoTitle: App mo sahaaji kaŋŋe ngam iPhone e Android
app.description: App Creative Activities mo alaa ko yoɓi : foto leelɗo nannduɗo e kaɓirɗe nay mawɗe, fotooji ɓesngu jogaaɗi e kaɓirgol maa, paɗe fotooje ɗe ngonaa e laylaytol.
app.lede: Kala ko njiɗɗaa e lowre ndee, e nder app golloowo e lowre ndee, baawɗo huutoraade fotooje galle ɗe cuɓ-ɗaa.
app.bodyHtml:
Fuɗɗoraade ko tokooso

Fuɗɗoraade e kaɓirɗe nay mawɗe e natal ganndaangal. Waɗde natal ina yiyee, walla suuɗa ɗum so ɗuum ina weltii. Mode Gentle alaa waktu, limre walla penaale. Suɓo 4, 6, 8 walla 12 tile.

Waɗde ɗum ko neɗɗo

Suɓo fotooje ɓesngu e cuɓoowo fotooje kaɓirgol maa. App oo ina moofta koppiiji tokoosi ngam golle mum. Nde ƴeewtataa defterdu maa walla waylataa fotooje maa asliije, nde jogoo fotde 24 foto e nder defterdu wooturu.

Ƴeewee tan e nder gootal

Yiylo natal gootal e sahaa gooto. Jaɓɓungal cuɓangal ina nodda yeewtere tawa naamnaaki hay gooto siftorde inɗe walla rokkude jaabawol laaɓtungol. Ƴeewde tan ina heddi.

Offline ɗo ɗum haani

Nate puɗɗorɗe e denndaangal paɗe natal jeetati ina tawee e app oo. Koppiiji fotooji naatnaaɗi ina ngolloo tawa ko e laylaytol. Suɓaade asliiji mooftaaɗi tan e iCloud ina waawi ɗaɓɓude jokkorde internet.

Alaa konte, alaa serveer sinkronisaasiyoŋ foto

Koppiiji fotooji ɓesngu ina keddii e app oo e kaɓirgol ngol. Aɗa waawi ittude koppiiji ɗii tawa a momtaani asliiji ɗii. Backups kaɓirɗe ina mbaawi jogaade dokke app. Janngu ko... politik sirlu app, be ballal app ina yaha e kala taƴre.
app.disclaimer: Creative Activities ko ngam weltinde e yeewtere renndinde. Nde ƴeewtataa, nde safrataa, nde haɗataa walla nde foondataa ñawu nguu walla ñawu Alzheimer’s.

gamesIndex.description: Ɗuuɗe internet bila kuɗe ngam mawɓe, fedde e ɓe ngalɗe dementia: ɗereeji ɗe suuɗaaɗe, puzzle ɗo ɓuri, tokkugo, hakkilo ɗe ... e bingo. Alal kuuɗe ngalaa, ngalaa wakkati walla jaabaaji.
gamesIndex.lede: {count} pijirlooji ɗi ngalaa njoɓdi ngam fijde e nder feerorde maa. Nate mawɗe, konnguɗi laaɓtuɗi, alaa ko ŋakki : alaa waktuuji, alaa limtooji, alaa winnditaade.
gamesIndex.byStageLede: Daawe ko njillu ɓuuɓngu tan. Rew ko neɗɗo oo weltotoo e ko weltotoo hannde.
gamesIndex.moreHtml: Hakkilo ngam ɗuuɗugo to bee ekran: 101 hakkilo ɗuuɗugo, ɗuuɗe ngam dementia nder suudu e sanaaji.

faq.a: Natal ɗiɗo e tiles nay ko suɓngo adanngo calminaango. So tawii suɓaade hakkunde natal ina nanndi e ko heewi, ƴeew Yiytu ko nanndi e natal ɗiɗi. Ngam fedde, ƴeew bingo Natal.

faq.q: Mbele pijirlooji ɗii ina ngolloo e iPad walla e telefoŋ?
faq.a: Oho. Kala fijo ina gollira e nder navigateur e telefoŋaaji, tablette e ordinateeruuji, natal ina mawna haa hebbina ekran. Tablet e dow stand ina heewi ɓurde welde e yimɓe ɗiɗo.

faq.q: Mbele ɗeen pijirlooji ina moƴƴi e neɗɗo mo Alzheimer's ?
faq.a: Oho. Ɗe mbaɗiraa ko yimɓe wonduɓe e ñawu nguu, ina jeyaa heen ñawu Alzheimer, ngu ɓuri heewde saabaade ɗum. Nate ina keddii ina kollita, ko seeɗa tan cuɓaa, alaa ko woni heen so wonaa waktuuji walla toɓɓe, ko ɗum waɗi pijirlooji ɗii ina tuugnii e anndude geɗe ganndaaɗe, wonaa siftorde geɗe kese.

faq.q: Mbele ɗeen pijirlooji ciftorgol ko mawɓe?
faq.a: Ɗum ɗuuɗe ɗereeji e tokkugo ɗe mawɓe fuu ngalu ɗuuɗugo, amma ɗum waɗaaɗe ngam walaa ɗuuɗugo hakkilo: nder ɗuuɗe ɗereeji, ɗereeji ngalu nder ekran ɗum ... tawɗe. Ɗuuɗe hakkilo fuu ngalaa sɗaɗ e ... ɗo nder ɗum ngalu ɗuuɗugo ɓeeɗaaɗe, si ɗo ɗum ɓaawo wakkati e jaabaaji.

faq.q: Mbele ina woodi pijirlooji ngam pelle e nder galle toppitiiɗo?
faq.a: Oho. Bingo natal ina jogii kaayitaaji tappirde e nodduɗo e ekran, e Finish the saying e kaayitaaji Yeewtere ina ngolloo no moƴƴi janngeede e daande toownde e fedde.

faq.q: Mbele app Moments kaŋŋe oo ko mbelnaari?
faq.a: Oho. Ko mbelnaari ƴettude, alaa ko woni heen ads, konte walla coodguuli nder app.

faq.q: Mbele app oo ina golla tawa internet alaa?
faq.a: Oho. Nate puɗɗorɗe ɗee e denndaangal paɗe nate jeetati ɗee ina tawee e app oo, fotooje ɓesngu ɗee ina ngolloo tawa ko e laylaytol so ɗe njuppaama e nder app oo. Suɓaade foto mooftiraaɗo tan e iCloud ina waawi hatojinde e jokkorde.

faq.q: Mbele miɗo waawi huutoraade fotooje galle amen?
faq.a: Oho. Suɓo fotooje e cuɓoowo fotooje kaɓirgol maa. App oo ina jogii koppiiji tokoosi e kaɓirgol ngol ngam golle mum, o ƴettataa ɗi, o meeɗaa waylude asliiji ɗii. Aɗa waawi ittude koppi ɗii kala sahaa.

faq.q: Mbele ko app jannginde ngaandi walla jarribaade miijo?
faq.a: Alaa. Creative Activities ko ngam weltinde e sahaa gooto. Alaa ko nde jogii limre walla ƴeewndo, nde ƴeewtataa, nde safrataa, nde haɗataa walla nde foondataa ñawu nguu walla ñawu Alzheimer’s.

gameFaqYes.q: Mbele ina woodi mbaydi app e ooɗoo fijo?
gameFaqYes.a: Oho. App Creative Activities mo alaa ko yoɓi ngam iPhone, iPad e Android ina jogii nanondiral natal leefngal gootal, ina waawi huutoraade fotooje ɓesngu ɗe cuɓ-ɗaa, kadi ina gollira tawa aɗa woni e laylaytol. Alaa konte, ads walla score.

gameFaqNo.q: Mbele ina woodi mbaydi app e ooɗoo fijo?
gameFaqNo.a: Wonaa e ooɗoo fijo. App Creative Activities mo alaa ko yoɓi ngam iPhone, iPad e Android ina waɗi natal ɓuuɓngal jokkondirngal e kaɓirɗe mawɗe e fotooji ɓesngu ɗi cuɓ-ɗaa, kadi ina golloo tawa aɗa woni e laylaytol. Ooɗoo fijo ina heddii ɗoo e feerorde maa.

gamePage.noscript: Ooɗoo fijo ina sokli JavaScript udditaaɗo e nder feerorde maa. Wasiyaaji les ɗii ina ngolloo tawa alaa heen.
gamePage.tips: Wasiyaaji ngam fijde e nder renndo
gamePage.newToPlayingHtml: Ɗo ɗuuɗugo fedde e mawɓe walla e ɓe ngalɗe dementia kadi? Naɓa hoto ɗuuɗugo fedde, e ɗum ɗe waɗaa si ɗum ɓaawo ɗuuɗugo.
gamePage.appText: App Creative Activities mo alaa kaalis ina jogii natal ɓuuɓngal jokkondirngal e kaɓirɗe mawɗe e fotooji ɓesngu maa, kadi ina gollira tawa Wi‐Fi alaa. Ayfoon, ipad e androyid.
gamePage.photoAppText: E nder app Creative Activities mo alaa kaalis, fotooje ɗe cuɓ-ɗaa ɗee ina keddii e kaɓirgol maa ngam sahaa garoowo, kadi pijirlooji ina ngolloo tawa Wi‐Fi alaa. Ayfoon, ipad e androyid.
gamePage.goodToKnowText: Ooɗoo fijo ko ngam weltinde e sahaa gooto. Nde ƴeewndataa, nde foondataa, nde safrataa hay huunde.

print.heading: Ɗuuɗugo nder kaaɗe
print.sameRules: Ɗuuɗe nder kaaɗe ngalu ɗereeji ɗeeɗe ɗe ɗuuɗe nder ekran:
print.pageNote: Hoore wonde nder A4 walla US Letter, ɗum ɓaawo nder black e white. Yeɗɗitol {date}.
print.islandNote: Ɗum printa ɗum ngalu nder ekran jooni. Yeɗɗitol {date}.
print.point: Nder kaaɗe, ɗaɓɓitee ɗereeji ɗe nder ekran, walla ɗaɓɓitee ɗereeji nder peen. Ɗum ɗi ... ɗereeji ɗe ɗum ... ɗo ɓeeɗaaɗe.
print.pointTarget: Nder kaaɗe, ɗereeji ngam ɗaɓɓitee ɗo nder kuutal ɗo ɗuuɗe ɗuuɗe. Ɗaɓɓitee ɗereeji nder peen walla ɗaɓɓitee ɗo nder ekran.
print.halves: Each picture is cut down the middle. Draw a line from each half on the left to the half on the right that fits it, or point with a finger. Nothing needs cutting.
print.grid: Gorol fuu ngalu lammbe. Ɗaɓɓitee lammbe ɗo nder keyi, e waɗaa gorol ɗo ngalu peen ɗe ɗuuɗe. Peen fooluɗe kadi wonno.
print.colors: Jamaa fuu ngalu peen. Ɗaɓɓitee ɗereeji fuu ɗe ngalu peen ɗum, walla ɗaɓɓitee nder peen. Jamaa ɗo ɗo ɗuuɗe.
print.dice: Jamaa fuu ngalu ɗereeji. Suɓɓitee jamaa, walla ɗaɓɓitee ɗereeji ɗi ɗuuɗe ɗo nder ɗum e hiirugo ngam ɗum ɗe ɗi ɗo ɗuuɗe. Ɗuuɗe ɗo mbaɗɗo tawa.
print.words: Ɗaɓɓitee kelme, walla ɗaɓɓitee lanndi ɗo kelme ɗo ngalu ɗereeji ɗum. Ɗaŋgitee kelme nder kelle yo ɗuuɗe.
print.cards: Ɗaɓɓitee kaarte ɗi nder dowmooji. Ɗume kaarte ɗi nder dukkitol, ɗaɓɓitee jaɓɓi.
print.chain: Nder kaaɗe, ɗaŋgitee ɗereeji hakkunde-hakkunde, ɗo ɗo ... Ɓe ngalɗe, nder fuu, ɗuuɗugo jaɓɓi hakkilo ɗi ɗereeji, ɗaɓɓitee ɗereeji ɗo ɗuuɗe. Mbaɗɗo tawa.
print.sort: Ɗaɓɓitee ɗereeji nder dowmooji, ɗaŋgitee ɗo ɗereeji ɗo nder kawte ɗo ɗum ngalu.
print.puzzle: Ɗaɓɓitee ɗereeji mawngo nder dowmooji nder nayi, ɗaŋgitee ɗo ɗo ... Waɗaa ɗereeji ɗo ngalu hakkunde haa ɗereeji ɗum ɓaawo. Ɗereeji ɗo ngalu ... ɗum e misaali.
print.cutSafety: Kawɗo ɗo ɗaɓɓitee ɗum fuɗɗaaɗe. Ɗeɓɓitee makaasi ɗo ... nder ɗum.

reasons.photos: Walaa ɗuuɗe nder kaaɗe. Ɗuuɗe ɗo waɗaa ɗereeji ɗe ɗo ... ɗereeji ɗi ... nder browser maaɗa, ɗi walaa ɗaɓɓitaaɗe ... ɗum ɗo site ɗo ɗaɓɓitay. Ngam ɗuuɗugo nder kaaɗe, printa ɗereeji ɗi dow suudu, e jamaa ɗereeji ɗi nder ɗemngal.
reasons.paced: Walaa ɗuuɗe nder kaaɗe. Ɗo daraja nder ekran ɗum ngalu tokkugo ɗo ... e kaaɗe ɗo ɗum waɗaa ɗo, ɗum ɗuuɗe ɗeɗɗe ɗeeɗe. Dooɓɗe ɗeɗɗe ɗo nder ɗeeɗe ɗe walaa ekran ɗum ɗo ɓaawo.
reasons.turns: Walaa ɗuuɗe nder kaaɗe ɗo ɗuuɗe ɗo. Ngam ɗaɓɓitee jaɓɓi nder ɗemngal, printa kaarte ɗereeji ɗi ɗo Picture pairs e ɗuuɗe kaɗe-kaɗe ɗo ɗereeji ɗi.
reasons.screen: Ce n'est pas disponible sur papier. C'est une image à regarder ensemble sur un écran ; une photo ou une carte postale préférée posée sur la table fait la même chose.
reasons.wash: Ce n'est pas disponible sur papier. L'aquarelle sur papier suit la même idée : un pinceau mouillé et une seule couleur à la fois.
reasons.sayings: Ce n'est pas encore disponible sur papier. Sur papier, chaque fin apparaîtrait d'un coup, et l'étape douce « Montrer la fin » serait perdue. Lisez les dictons ensemble à l'écran, ou partagez-en quelques-uns que vous connaissez tous les deux.
